sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Dina was exploring phone conversations. The aim was to have a clear, natural conversation in English. Dina said, “Hello, this is Dina speaking.” A friend replied, “May I ask who's calling?” Dina said, “I'm calling about my appointment.” A friend replied, “Is now a convenient time to talk?” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I'm a little busy at the moment.” A friend replied, “Could I call you back in ten minutes?” Dina said, “Of course, take your time.” A friend replied, “Sorry, I missed your call.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “My phone was on silent.”

sections.heading: In conversation
paragraphs: The conversation continued, and Dina practiced listening and responding with care. Dina said, “I didn't recognize the number.” A friend replied, “Can you hear me clearly?” Dina said, “Your voice is breaking up.” A friend replied, “The connection is not very good.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “Let me move somewhere quieter.” A friend replied, “Could you repeat the last part?” Dina said, “I didn't catch the address.” A friend replied, “I'll send the details by message.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “Would you mind speaking more slowly?”

sections.heading: Practicing details
paragraphs: Next, Dina practiced phrases that could help with common problems and decisions. Dina said, “Please hold for a moment.” A friend replied, “I'll check that information for you.” Dina said, “Thank you for waiting.” A friend replied, “I'm afraid she's unavailable right now.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “Would you like to leave a message?” A friend replied, “Please tell her I called.” Dina said, “When would be a good time to reach her?” A friend replied, “I can try again this afternoon.” They paused to remember the meaning.

sections.heading: Putting it together
paragraphs: Before finishing, Dina reviewed more useful sentences and noticed real improvement. Dina said, “I think we got disconnected.” A friend replied, “I was just about to call you.” Dina said, “Can we switch to a video call?” A friend replied, “Let me turn on my microphone.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “The camera is not working.” A friend replied, “We've covered everything I needed.” Dina said, “Thanks for taking my call.” A friend replied, “Have a lovely rest of your day.” They paused to remember the meaning.
